author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ज्ञानमपि तदर्थं स्मारयत्यनेनेत्यदोषः ।  हे महाबाहो यो द्वेषाकाङ्क्षादिहीनः ।  काम्यकर्मत्यागी चेत्युपलक्ष्यते ।  स नित्यसंन्यासी ज्ञेयः स्मर्तव्य इत्यर्थः ।  स एव सुखं यथा भवति तथा अनायासेन बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते ।  हि प्रसिद्धमिति युद्धकर्म त्वया न त्याज्यमिति
translation: V. He....loves: The Lord means that Sanyâsa in this context is the eschewing of passions, vis, love and late &c. but not the particular form of life called, Sanyasa. He who is free from such passions is indeed always a Sanyâsin, Further the term implies the abandoning of all Kamya Karma, i.e., duties of works done with motives, for limited ends. Only such a real Sanyasin obtains release with ease from samsâra. Indeed (hi) shows that this is an established fact. Hence Arjuna is enjoined not to abandon his duty of going to war.
